'''Grasper arms''' were [[Manipulator arm/Legends|appendages]] that allowed [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that did not possess [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] to manipulate objects such as [[Computer/Legends|computer]] keypads and tools. They were commonly found on [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromechs]] and [[Power droid/Legends|power droids]] and were usually retractable, folding up into compartments within the droid's body.<ref name="CFTD" /> There were exceptions to this, such as the grasper arms used on the [[P2-series astromech droid|P2-series]] and the [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX-series medical assistant]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

Grasper arms came in two main versions; one for fine work, and another for heavy lifting. The arms were extendable with a range of around half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]]<ref name="CFTD" /> although some droids such as the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] had arms that could reach up to 0.85 meters.<ref name="EGTD" /> [[Servomotor/Legends|Servo]]-boosted mechanisms were built into the arm's joints and "fingers." The grasper arms came in a number of varieties, tipped with either claws, pincers, or hands with a varying number of fingers.<ref name="CFTD" />
